status: Strict provisional visual-fidelity targets requested by user; feasibility and theoretical minimum are NOT proven
selection_rule: Reject failed rollouts; prefer lower yaw and joint errors with stable posture. Passing numeric targets still needs video review; do not align away yaw errors or retime targets to improve scores.
scope: Final numerical training-stop gate only; failed quality checks continue learning. Passing still requires visual review. These are stricter engineering targets, not a certified attainable lower bound.
training_stop_policy: Early falls, tracking errors and fluctuating rewards continue learning. Continuous mode stops on two independent nominal checkpoints passing these targets plus all three reset-perturbed confirmation seeds, or genuine numerical/resource faults or user stop. Visual review remains required; this is not proof of mathematical convergence.
basis: Root 0.10/0.25 m is near an already observed 0.082/0.230 m checkpoint. Heading 5/20 deg, tilt 5/15 deg and joint 0.20 rad are stricter improvement goals; joint/segment attainability is unproven. No claim of a paper-derived theoretical minimum or imperceptible visual differences.

metric_definitions.tilt: Angle between actual and reference gravity directions in their respective root frames; not absolute tilt from vertical.
metric_definitions.joint_rmse: Pooled actual minus refreshed-reference joint angles in radians; unchanged time sampling, no retiming.
metric_definitions.arms_joint_rmse: Pooled shoulder, elbow and wrist joint RMSE over the entire recorded clip.
metric_definitions.worst_2s_joint_rmse: Maximum pooled all-joint RMSE across every full 2-second sample window (100 samples at 50 Hz), with one-sample stride.
metric_definitions.root: Absolute 3D root-position distance to retargeted robot reference, no translation alignment.
